integrity: All-order proof uses a universal Rayleigh witness, a positive ground-state transform and characterization of equality. Exact finite checks supplement but do not prove the theorem; publication priority subject to unindexed equivalent literature.
scientific_limitations: Sharp iid fixed-probability one-step worst-direction Euclidean squared-error contraction for consistent normalized adjacent differences and exactly two endpoint anchors; not optimal exact N-step MSE, asymptotic annealed exponent, noise, adaptive sampling or arbitrary row weights. Parity-dependent zero probabilities are permitted.
title: Parity-forced omission and a complete optimizer face for Kaczmarz sampling on endpoint-anchored paths
